notes: «جَمِيعاً» marks the three co-transmitters whose routes meet at محمد بن عيسى: one level of three
the Imam «أبي عبد الله» is written inside the chain after «عن», so kind narrator; «عليه السلام» and «رضي الله عنه» are left out
«محمد بن الحسن» is written twice, as two men with their own «حدثنا»: the first alone, then الصفار in the next level
